AC5 LIVE MEASUREMENT (run 31003041092, artifact structured-output-baseline-{anthropic,bedrock,openai}, 20 samples/cell). Per-cell parse-success new_ok/n, current->sentinel directive:
- anthropic: 6/20 -> 12/20 (+6; fenced 11->0)
- bedrock:   9/20 -> 11/20 (+2; fenced 15->0)
- openai:   20/20 -> 19/20 (-1)
NON-REGRESSION vs a40f baseline: CONFIRMED. The single openai dip is a MARKERLESS content-validity miss (model returned findings as strings) routed through the byte-for-byte-unchanged markerless path -> reproducible pre-change, i.e. sampling noise, NOT a parser regression. Net: material improvement, no regression attributable to the change.
HONEST CAVEAT on channel compliance: under this matrix proxy (SENTINEL_DIRECTIVE appended to bare production prompts) live marker adoption was 0/20 across providers; models honored 'single object, no fence' (the source of the parse gains) but did not emit the literal markers. The NO-DECOY-WIN + fail-closed safety guarantee (the actual defect-class elimination) is proven offline by the deterministic unit oracle (113 tests incl. held-out fail-closed/reverse-iterate/line-anchor/empty-block pins), independent of live compliance. Filing a discovered-work follow-up to raise live marker adoption.
